description.narrative: BIRN Albania is a non-governmental media organization. This is an un-earmarked support to the Strategic Plan 2021-2025. Through high quality investigative reporting and a pool of skilled journalists, BIRN Albania examines and scrutinizes key processes, promotes debates and provides the public with impartial and reliable information. By making available data and public documents, BIRN will enable journalists and researchers to be in a better position to hold institutions and policymakers accountable in the progress made for the implementation of the commitments taken in the fight against organized crime and corruption. BIRN Albania will support journalists’ coverage from the regions, to bring the voice of the voiceless in the national debate and the public sphere, particularly for abuses linked with the environment and stories that provide a gender perspective. BIRN Albania will work with experts, donors and partners to strengthen its procedures in terms of gender mainstreaming, the integration of environment perspective, data protection and privacy.

BIRN Albania är en icke-statlig medieorganisation. Detta är ett icke öronmärkt stöd till den strategiska planen 2021–2025. Genom undersökande rapportering av hög kvalitet och en pool av skickliga journalister undersöker och granskar BIRN Albanien nyckelprocesser, främjar debatter och förser allmänheten med opartisk och tillförlitlig information. Genom att tillgängliggöra data och offentliga dokument kommer BIRN att göra det möjligt för journalister och forskare att vara i en bättre position för att hålla institutioner och beslutsfattare ansvariga för de framsteg som görs för att genomföra de åtaganden som gjorts i kampen mot organiserad brottslighet och korruption. BIRN Albania kommer att stödja journalisters bevakning från regionerna, för att föra fram de röstlösa i den nationella debatten och i det offentliga rummet, särskilt för övergrepp kopplade till miljön och berättelser som ger ett jämställdhetsperspektiv. BIRN Albania kommer att arbeta med experter, givare och partners för att stärka sina förfaranden när det gäller jämställdhetsintegrering, integrering av miljöperspektiv, dataskydd och integritet.

The objective of the intervention is that Albanian society upholds democratic values and freedoms allowing citizens equal opportunities to make informed choices and hold government accountable. The desired changes that BIRN Albania aims to achieve through its core programme during the period 2021 2025 are the following: 1) People have increased access to accurate information; 2) People have increased influence on democratic process: 3) People have increased opportunities to claim their rights; 4) Internal capacities of the organization are strengthened.

description.narrative:
During 2023, BIRN has been able to increase its media productions in order to provide people with information and raising their awareness on issues of public interest increases citizens understanding, helps them make informed decisions and gives them the tools to demand changes. The articles produced have been read 2.78 million time (pages viewed), while its videos have been viewed 1.64 million times.
The reach of the stories has been further amplified by more than 11,900 full-text republications in other national and local media outlets. In addition, stories firstly researched and published by BIRN have steered the public debate and have pushed other media to produce follow up stories and TV programs on the same topics. BIRN stories have registered at least 50 front pages in the national print, as well as at least 400 news editions in national and local TV stations.
The stories published by BIRN in the previous years have produced direct impact through the investigations of the Special Prosecutor against Corruption and Organized Crime (SPAK) during 2023, such as on the cases of incinerators, strategic investors, PPPs in health and energy sector, lobbying contracts of political parties, etc., which are detailed below in this report.
In addition to its ongoing areas of focus, during 2023, BIRN has strengthened its reporting in new areas / topics, mostly related to electoral processes, coverage of parliamentary proceedings, as well as reporting on digital rights violations. Also, based on the core support, BIRN has increased its use of data, visualizations and videos in order to attract new audiences.
BIRN has continued to support to local journalists, both by enabling the development of their knowledge and practical skills through formal training and on-the-job mentoring, as well as through the financial support to produce around 550 articles and videos on topics important to local communities from all the regions of the country.
During 2023, BIRN Albania has continually made use of the law On the right to information in order to make public institutions transparent and their decision-making process accessible, by publishing new datasets and provide to other journalists and researchers access to more than 2,900 additional public documents. Also, BIRN Albania has continued to monitor and report on daily basis on the justice reform and judicial institutions though data published and analyzed through online databases; visualization and publication of analyses on the wealth of individual judges and prosecutors; monitoring of each session of the vetting institutions and continuous reporting on their work; in-depth analyses on the work of new justice institutions; publication of the asset declarations forms filed by judges and prosecutors in an online and interactive document library by creating the largest open source database on judiciary in Albania.
BIRN Albania has focused in conducting several research initiatives related to information manipulation in the country. In such regards, BIRN has produced the first set of studies on Albania, as well as has joint forces with international organizations to produce the database on Media Ownership Monitor 2023, as well as report on more than 240 cases of digital rights violations in the country.
